title: Houston heat leads TTF/HH ratio
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Houston maximum temperature 20d z-score > 1.0 (US cooling demand lifts Henry Hub, the denominator) leads the TTF to Henry Hub ratio by 3 days (-); control for the Doha-heat result, trade short TTF/HH ratio 3d [weather.houston.temp_max -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0027)
message: Not supported: Houston heat z>1 does not lead TTF/HH ratio at 3d (r=-0.09 best lag, short-ratio backtest hit 0.40, sharpe -1.6, actionability 2.31)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.houston.temp_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short ratio:ttf_henryhub next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
